html_title: StreetZim — Taswirori ba tare da intanet ba don Kiwix
meta_description: Taswirorin OpenStreetMap kyauta, masu aiki gaba ɗaya ba tare da intanet ba, don manhajar karatu ta Kiwix. Tayil ɗin vector, hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam, ƙasa a 3D da bayanan Wikipedia — suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba a iOS, Android, Mac, Windows da Linux.
tagline: Taswirorin OpenStreetMap masu aiki gaba ɗaya ba tare da intanet ba, don manhajar karatu ta Kiwix. Tayil ɗin vector, hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam, ƙasa a 3D da Wikipedia — ba a buƙatar intanet.
maps_intro: Zaɓi yanki a ƙasa, shigar da Kiwix, sannan ka buɗe fayil ɗin .zim. An ajiye taswirorin a Internet Archive — kowane saukewa yana da torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Zaɓi yanki a ƙasa ka sauke shi da Hausa: sunayen da ke kan taswirar, bincike da Wikipedia duk da Hausa ne. Buɗe fayil ɗin a Kiwix, manhaja ce ta kyauta; shafin kowace taswira yana nuna yadda ake yi, mataki-mataki.
feature_key_intro: Alamomin da ke kan kowane kati suna nuna abin da ke ciki:
badge_nav_desc: jagorar juyi-juyi ba tare da intanet ba,
badge_overture_desc: shafukan yanar gizo, lambobin waya da kafofin sada zumunta daga Overture,
badge_photo_desc: nemo wuri daga hoton allon sanarwa.
what_lead: StreetZim yana tattara bayanan OpenStreetMap — na ƙasashe ko nahiyoyi gaba ɗaya — cikin fayil ɗaya na ZIM da za ka iya buɗewa a Kiwix. Yana aiki gaba ɗaya ba tare da intanet ba: babu sabar, babu kiran API, ba a buƙatar intanet bayan saukewar farko.
what_p2: Ba kamar sauran manhajojin taswira marasa intanet masu amfani da tayil na hoto ba, StreetZim yana amfani da tayil ɗin vector da ake zanawa a kan na'urarka ta hanyar MapLibre GL JS. Sakamakon: motsa taswira, zuƙowa da juyawa cikin sauƙi, har ma da ƙasa a 3D — duka daga fayil ɗaya a kan na'urarka.
feat_vector_p: Taswirori masu kyau kuma bayyanannu har zuwa matakin titi, bisa tsarin OpenMapTiles, MapLibre na zana su nan take.
feat_sat_p: Hotunan Sentinel-2 marasa gajimare, masu ƙudurin mita 10, na dukan yankin taswirar.
feat_terrain_p: Inuwar tuddai da tsayin ƙasa a 3D daga Copernicus GLO-30, samfurin tsayin ƙasa na duniya.
feat_wiki_p: Taɓa kowane birni, dutse ko sanannen wuri don ganin maƙalarsa ta Wikipedia da muhimman bayanai.
feat_search_p: Bincika cikin miliyoyin sunayen wurare, tituna, wuraren shakatawa, ƙololuwar duwatsu, filayen jirgin sama da sauran wurare.
feat_offline_h: Ba tare da intanet ba da gaske
feat_offline_p: Fayil ɗaya kawai na .zim. Babu asusu, babu bin diddigi, babu hanyar sadarwa. Buɗe ka fara.
step1_p: Manhajar karatu ta kyauta don iOS, Android, Mac, Windows da Linux. Samo ta a kiwix.org. A Windows da Linux, a yanzu ka buɗe taswirori a Kiwix PWA: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 yana nuna su babu komai, kuma gyaransa yana cikin sigogin gwaji na kullum (nightly) kawai zuwa yanzu.
step2_p: Zaɓi yanki a sama ka sauke fayil ɗin .zim (ko ka yi amfani da torrent don ƙarin sauri).
step2_p_lang: Zaɓi yanki a sama ka danna maɓallin saukewarsa: za ka sami taswirar da Hausa, a matsayin fayil ɗaya na .zim.
step3_p: Buɗe fayil ɗin .zim a manhajar Kiwix. Shi ke nan — taswirar tana aiki gaba ɗaya ba tare da intanet ba.
sources_intro: An gina StreetZim gaba ɗaya daga buɗaɗɗun bayanai. Kowace taswirar ZIM tana ƙunshe da abubuwa daga waɗannan tushe:

src_elev: Tsayin ƙasa: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, Tarayyar Turai da ESA ne suka bayar ƙarƙashin shirin COPERNICUS.
src_place: Bayanan wuri: Wikidata (CC0) da Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
src_code: Lambar kayan aikin: StreetZim — lasisin MIT.
oss_intro: StreetZim yana dogara ga manhajojin karatu na Kiwix don buɗe fayilolin .zim. Kowace manhaja buɗaɗɗen tushe ce kuma ana haɓaka ta a GitHub:
footer: StreetZim aiki ne na buɗaɗɗen tushe. Lambar tana kan GitHub. An ajiye taswirorin a Internet Archive.

kg_h2: Yadda ake buɗe taswirar a Kiwix
kg_android_1: Shigar da Kiwix daga Google Play. Kyauta ne.
kg_android_2: Sauke taswirar a sama. Wayarka za ta ajiye ta a Downloads.
kg_android_3: Buɗe Kiwix, je ɗakin karatunsa ka ƙara fayil ɗin da ka sauke.
kg_ios_1: Shigar da Kiwix daga App Store. Kyauta ne.
kg_ios_2: Sauke taswirar a sama. Safari zai ajiye ta a manhajar Files, ƙarƙashin Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Buɗe Kiwix, je ɗakin karatunsa ka buɗe fayil ɗin daga Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Shigar da Kiwix daga Mac App Store, sannan ka buɗe fayil ɗin da ka sauke da shi.
kg_pc_1: Buɗe manhajar yanar gizo ta Kiwix a burauzarka ka zaɓi fayil ɗin da ka sauke. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 yana nuna waɗannan taswirori babu komai; gyaransa yana cikin sigogin gwaji na kullum (nightly) kawai zuwa yanzu.
kg_offline: Bayan haka, taswirar tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
hero_h1: Taswirori masu aiki ba tare da intanet ba
hero_apps: Ana buɗe su a manhajar Kiwix ta kyauta:
tour_lead: Duk abin da ke cikin waɗannan bidiyo yana fitowa ne daga fayil ɗaya a kan na'ura. An naɗe su ne bayan an yanke intanet; rubutun bayani da ɗigon da ke nuna kowace taɓawa kawai aka ƙara daga baya.
tour_photo_p: Ɗauki hoton allon titi, ƙofar shago ko adireshin da ke kan katin mabuɗin otal, sai taswirar ta nemi wurin da aka ambata. Ana karanta rubutun a kan na'urarka, da irin rubutun da aka rubuta shi: a nan Yukireniyanci, Girkanci, Larabci, Jafananci, Koriyanci, Sinanci da Turanci, gefe da gefe.
tour_photo_note: A taswirorin da ke da wannan alama.
tour_zoom_h: Daga dukan birni zuwa gini ɗaya
tour_zoom_p: Taswirorin vector suna zama bayyanannu a kowane mataki na zuƙowa: tashi daga dukan Kyiv zuwa gini ɗaya, sannan ka karkata ka juya taswirar.
tour_drive_p: Hanya ta ratsa Kyiv, an tsara ta a kan waya kuma an bi ta juyi-juyi. An naɗe ta da wurin kwaikwayo; tsakiyar tafiyar tana gudana da sauri sau goma.
tour_terrain_p: Inuwar tuddai, ƙasa a 3D da hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam: duwatsun da ke saman Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Bincike iri ɗaya a kowane irin rubutu, a kan taswirar birnin da allon yake.
tour_credits: Hotunan alluna, hoton ƙofar da hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam da ke cikin waɗannan bidiyo da hotunan allo na wasu ne: duba masu haƙƙi da lasisi.
gallery_lead: Hotunan allo na gaske daga taswirorin, a kwamfuta da a waya. Zaɓi ɗaya don ganinsa da cikakken girma, sannan ka duba sauran.
gal_place: Katin wuri da hoto da taƙaitaccen bayanin Wikipedia
gal_find: Nemo kafe, shaguna da sauransu a kusa
gal_route: Hanyar da aka tsara a kan waya
gal_terrain_sat: Ƙasa a 3D da hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam
gal_article: Maƙalar Wikipedia, ba tare da intanet ba
langs_lead: Sunayen wurare, bincike, jagorar hanya, maƙalolin Wikipedia da menu na taswirar kanta, a harshen da kake karantawa. Har da rubutun da ake rubutawa daga dama zuwa hagu.
langs_step1_p: Zaɓe shi a jerin da ke ƙasa, ko a menu da ke saman kowane shafi.
langs_step2_p: A shafin harshenka, babban maɓallin kowace taswira yana sauke taswirar da wannan harshe, a matsayin fayil ɗaya na .zim. Wannan shafi na Turanci yana ba da kowace taswira kamar yadda aka gina ta: sunayen wurare da harshen wurin, fuskar manhaja da Wikipedia da Turanci.
langs_step2_p_lang: A wannan shafi, babban maɓallin kowace taswira shi ne “Sauke da Hausa”: taswirar da sunayen wurarenta, bincike, Wikipedia da menu da Hausa, a matsayin fayil ɗaya na .zim. Inda taswira ba ta shirya da Hausa ba tukuna, katinta yana faɗin haka.
langs_step3_p: Ana iya yin taswirori da yawa da harsunan da ake magana a wurin, kamar Katalanci don Iberiya ko Welsh don Birtaniya da Ireland. Taswirori a wasu harsuna yana jera kowane harshe na kowace taswira kuma yana haɗa fayil ɗin a cikin burauzarka.
langs_demo_note: Taswira ɗaya ta Kyiv da Larabci, Ibrananci, Hindi, Thai, Jafananci da Sinanci. Sunan da ba shi da fassara yana zama kamar yadda ake rubuta shi a wurin.
langs_grid_note: Lambar tana nuna taswirori nawa ne suka shirya a wannan harshe a yau.
filter_none: Babu taswirar da ta dace. Gwada ƙasa, yanki ko birni.
credits_h: Hotunan da ke cikin bidiyo da hotunan allo
credits_intro: Bidiyo da hotunan allo suna nuna taswirorin yadda suke. Allunan da ke cikin binciken hoto, hoto ɗaya na wani sanannen wuri da hotunan tauraron ɗan Adam aikin wasu ne, an yi amfani da su ƙarƙashin waɗannan lasisi. An yanke hotunan allunan.
